I would Def recommend that you organize your work to make finding it more user-friendly. Overall, well done.

I love it ♥, easy to use and so convenient...don't have to worry about loosing any photos and there're kept organize! I do wish thou, that there would be a way to remove duplicate photos, that is a main problem for me😬... When I first got this app there was a way to remove duplicate photos but now there's no way! Can you please, see if you can help with the double photos... I'd really appreciate it very much... The App is 5⭐⭐⭐⭐🌟 Thank you!♥

The most amazing way to store your photos! It is so easy to find previously taken pics!! You can search photos by location, thing, holiday, person, month or year!! It recognizes faces and creates folders for each person. If I want to make a collage of my kids, I can easily bring up every photo that has my kids in it. People are always impressed with how quick I can find a pic that was taken years ago! Best app ever!!

Terrible app. There is no mass camera roll, instead the default storage of photos is by date, which just looks and feels more unorganized. Counterintuitive I know, but it's true. Photos taken in airplane mode just default to a random date, meaning you can't find them very easily when you want to see them, and obviously they aren't in the correct chronology of when you took them. Automatically creates random photo folders without adding those photos to your camera roll. 1 star do not recommend.

This app is great for sharing photos and viewing them. Editing is also good and its quite easy to crop or rotate pictures. Plus, the ability to upload my pictures to the cloud and thus not taking any space on my phone is awesome! However, there have been many instances in which photos were only showed as a gray screen instead of the actual photo. I'm not sure if thats because the photo never really existed or if the app is just glitching but it's very annoying and bothersome. please fix this!!!!

Two main grudges at present. With thousands of photos it is virtually impossible to organise them without extremely tedious efforts. No way to select photos that are NOT in any album, so you are left with lots of "orphans" - very frustrating. Secondly, and related, is the lack of a two or more tier structure to store albums. You end up with either countless smaller albums, or fewer albums with countless photos in each. Not good :-{ However, there are many great features overall, granted :-)

Another Gallery app that spoon-feeds photo organization by what THEY want - by date. Give me a gallery that simply displays my photos the way I have organized them - in directories, IN ALPHABETICAL ORDER, nothing more !! Google programmers can't seem to be able to do a simple array. What I see is a random list of directories, not based on any alphabet known to man, making it impossible to find a photo. Your AI search is useless in searching for abstracted photos, etc.

The functionality of this app is better than most photo apps. However, managing photos would be easier if creating an album and putting pictures in to said album then took them out of your camera roll. I like the idea of an album being locked so the contents are secure, say, for example if a child was to play with your phone. Are these things possible to implement?

I absolutely love Google Photos. I have used this app for years and would never go anywhere else for app to store my photos. It keeps them organized, and frees up my phone. All the categories and options are great. My favorite part is that Google occasionally makes these REALLY GREAT clips, videos, and collages with your photos. Adds music and all sorts of things to them. All this for free? Bet!

It may just be me, and that's fine, but I'm completely lost with Google photos. I just got the new BlackBerry Priv and overall I've been very happy with it, with the exception of Google photos. BlackBerry - you're partially to blame for this too. Whether it's my memory card or settings that I can't figure out how to change, whenever I download photos from Facebook or Twitter, etc they don't go into my photos folder. I have no clue where they are. For a long time BlackBerry user, this is overly difficult

The app is fine, but their help center is absolute garbage. I ordered 80 photos, and they were delivered to the wrong address, so I went onto the website to try and sort out the issue, get them replaced or refunded, I'm a pretty chill human being, and their so called "help center" just took me in circles, telling me to go to this, click here, and then do this, which would just bring me back to the page that told me to do that. at the end of the day, I still have 0 clue where the photos I ordered are, and I can't get ahold of anyone to help me find them.

Pros: intuitive, direct and free storage within Google network, face label, albums, photo scanning, stylized cool pics, grouped memory collages Cons: not enough photo editing capabilities, wish it was easier to tag a person in a photo, need more photo editing from within app. between the pixel 3xl and the Google photos we should be able to do it all, but especially blemishes, smiles, red eyes, scenery, let's make it easy to show what this camera can do in fogg or in the rain.

Terrific quality! Always adding valuable features like copying text off a menu, for example, so you can forward it in a message or save it in a document. It also lets you take a picture of something -- a flower or bird, for example -- and it will identify it for you. You can also doctor the lighting in photos and fix other flaws. Couldn't live without it!

Step 1: Offer something for free and kill other potential competitors Step 2: Everyone is invested in your ecosystem so raise the prices now that they have no alternatives anymore. Step 3: ??? Step 4: PROFIT!!! If this ain't a classic tactic of bait-and-switch, I don't know what else. I should've stuck with OneDrive that I already had instead of moving to Google Photos, only to have to move them back, a totally pointless endeavor... No reason to fragment my photo library over a pointless app.

I would be lost wothout my google photos. I love that i can log onto any device and get access to my photos and videos. It would be nice if there was more editing features with it that are easy to use (for beginners) or perhaps a add-on download that has that feature. I love some of the photos it edits and suggest to me i just wish i knew how to make them like that. Either way still awesome!

Mostly good, but wish better organizing. Features missing, such as After archiving pics from main bucket, to be able to share pics in albums, that were archived in main view bucket. Actually better, would be able to select pics & "move" them into an album, like Google Drive can do. Take them out of the main view, as I call the primary/main bucket. Very cluttered; can't remember which pics I've already put into albums.... very annoying 😒.

Since the last update photos taken with the Phone camera will show normally for about a second, then automatically boost the light sources in the picture. I could not find a way to turn this "feature" off. While some photos might look better with the "enhancement", the big issue is that the photos you see in the photos app will be very different than the same photos you share on another app. Please give users a way to disable this nonsense, or turn it into a tool in the image editor.

it's great at backing up photos. But when trying to delete large number of photos, you have to select in groups (as you cannot select all, even with scrolling). With large number of photos, this is a pain and takes way too much time. In one forum I found you have to search (in my case, search by year) and then select those photos to delete. Could improve on managing storage. They seem to want to push you into paying for more cloud storage.

💕 I enjoy the Google photos app very much!! A very convenient way to store photos and super fun too editing them! It stores your photos away and as soon as you click on Google Photos, your new photos immediately arrive and are saved to Google photos. Also they are not shared and are marked private until you actually share them. Then they can see them or people can access them by a link. People wonder if everyone can see their photos but only he who owns the app can. Very smart app! 💕

I pay 1.99 to this app & I also use one drive also 1.99. Very similar, which is better? Depends on your device. I still use Windows Phones for my kids. I find i can limit a little more. But Photo, has a app known as PhotoScan, which makes perfect pics of items your wanting to share. Documents etc. However, if you use office- one drive is linked to your account and makes it easier for pc. So, i do both. Sometimes you can find yearly specials, its worth it. I personally prefer to get year specials.

I really like the automatic backup and unlimited photo storage. It has been great switching from iPhone to Android a few times over the past few years. My only beef, is that often when I try to upload photos to an album it will not save or keep the album with all of the images in it. I've tried updating the app, changing around certain settings and nothing seems to work, so that aspect of the albums is a hit or miss and can be somewhat frustrating at times.

I never think of saving photos from my phone, until my phone is a total loss. This app pops up seemingly at the best time and asks you to do so. And doesn't just save every photo, that would take me right out of decision. Just like this other PHONEI had it would save everything and have no space after a short time. Then you would have to buy a new one. But I'm sure that was the whole idea.

Since the update, every time I try to move one photo from one folder to another, the app creates a duplicate of said picture and doesn't let me back it up. I can't delete a duplicate without deleting the other one, so now I am stuck with the same photo in both folders. I tried saving from different sources (web, social media), but the same problem presents itself every time. Sometimes, the app doesn't even show the saved picture. I feel rather angry and disappointed.

Took a star away because of the difficulty of getting the app to do what you want not what it wants to do with the photos. I don't want them in archives I want to delete them. The app keeps wanting to send them to archives. There is also another update to install. Again Works great for me. I would have given it 5 stars but when you update it on the 25th and have to re-update it on the 27th again it shows you evrything can be improved on.

Easy to use, and I love how it brings up your memories. My original review is from 2016 which tells you I've been using it for a long time. Over the years of course they've tried to improve the app which has been a hit or miss. Sometimes it will automatically upload folders from your device that you have not selected to be uploaded which makes it frustrating because it removes it from your app once it uploads to the storage. Overall I still heavily use this app and still recommend it

You can do some really cool things with your pics with this app. I actually really love the suggestions they throw out at you periodically. They suggest fun animations and collages. They create books that you can edit and buy. I never would have thought to do that, and of course, I have to edit some pics to get these books just the way I want them, but it's cool that they suggest it and throw out ideas. Also, I like the "remember when," where they show you pics from years ago. Great to reminisce

I hate this app with a burning passion!!! The album's you create manually don't show up in other apps, not all of my photos are saved, and even when I delete stuff it comes back! The app has so many damn annoying and unnecessary features and the worst part is I can't delete it!! If I could give it negative stars I would! I just want a simple gallery app, damn!!!

I really enjoyed everything about this. I have a Pixel XL 2 so I'm enjoying the wonderful photos as well. I wish there was a way to create a private folder to put photos that you dont want anyone to see in there, and hide it like some Samsung devices give you. Also, once I did a back up of all my photos it removed them from the device and now I can't use them with Shutterfly app. All the other features are just great!!!!

UX has gotten progressively worse over time. It has become difficult to see where some of the automagically generated images (e.g. then and now, collages, etc.) are located after they pop up. Take for example the pop up, "New Version Available" when there is no new version available. I appreciate the app, but whomever is leading the product is leading it off of a cliff.

It's a really amazing app making videos appear with the repetition like tiktok. Although I had some saved videos a while ago and all of a sudden they disappeared from my home page, but if I were to log into my account on a pc they would show. Don't know why that was so...but I would like for it to be checked. All in all it's wonderful. Thanks Google!

Highlight videos sound is out of sync. Leaving a review of this app seems to be the only way to get in touch with Google about bugs so here we go. I love the option to make a highlight video out of my pics and vids, and it is quite easy to do. However, when publishing the video to my library the sounds always become out of sync. When I go back in and edit the highlight video the sound is fine again, but then after publishing the sound becomes more and more out of sync throughout the video.

Best app ever. Keeps absolutely every image and video backed up. Unlimited storage, everything in chronological order. You can search by key words of what is in the picture , from colors, to items, etc. And it will come up for the most part. It's amazing. Then the image animations , or collages and so much more that it puts together for you. It's truly an amazing app. Whether you're an iphone or Android user , we can ALL benefit greatly from this app.

A few issues have come up. I cannot use the "free up space" option. The app just closes or freezes when I click on it. Also, I ALWAYS have things backing up. Once in a while I will open the app and it will say "backup complete" but then one second later it says it's backing up 600 items. I have the setting set to backup using data. I have unistalled and reinstalled the app twice.

It's great to back up photos and albums in full quality. There are some slight frustrating bits to it though like the fact that you don't have the option to set the photos by last edited or modified. Other than that I love it, I use it to display my professional photos to my clients and it's easy for everyone to view and download the full quality album.

Well the app is really great. Though i wanna suggest a change if possible. So like in the locked folder , I think if the images i have saved in that folder once and i delete it from there , those pictures or videos shouldn't be deleted until a month or probably a week . I had deleted one of my pictures and when I try to restore it there was nothing at all available to do . So please, i would to like to request if that particular feature could be added. Anyways it's a great app.

It is very difficult to manage photos and videos here. Plus, for storage, you need to pay every month? If you are allowed to buy limited storage through one-time payment, I think more people will buy. Also, while clearing up storage from the phone, why can't we decide which media we want to delete? If 80% of my media is backed up in this app, all of it will vanish from my device!

This is the first app I've reviewed and gave one star (didn't even want to give one star). The main and only problem is, no matter how much you atop updating and turn back up off, turn youe sync off, it will still keep on syncing recent photos. Then it'll suddenly tell you that your storage is full and that way force you to buy more storage or else you won't recieve mails. Wow! Amazing isn't it?!

I either want an easy way to edit and sort my photos, or I want a reliable back-up. This is neither. This takes control of your photos, and offers little in return. It's also incredibly difficult to delete pictures from the Photos cloud without also deleting them from your device. There's very little control over how your pictures are organised on the cloud; the face-sorting is pretty dismal (even if I did want it, which I don't; and there doesn't seem to be a dark mode(?). The widget is cool

Love it! Pros: free high quality storage, great animations and collage, ease of use. Cons: edit a photo to rotate it (I wish it could do that automatically) and now the edited photo is no longer stored in the month it was taken, it's stored in the current month (I can't figure out how to put it back where it was. So I'm not editing anymore...), can't take a so-so photo out of a collage, no "bad-photo" assistant

i thought that the magic eraser did this thing where it, oh, what's that called, oh yeah...ERASES things!!! it erases NOTHING! I guarantee this issue will NOT get resolved and no one will respond to this! i even did the latest update, and still nothing. SHOCKER!!! PLEASE FIX THIS or get rid of it!!! right now, it's pointless!

It can be quite difficult (if u haven't checked the button to backup and sync, which I haven't) to see what is uploaded and what isn't simply from using the app. Also, worried now about using too much data and loss of storage space due to recent changes in policy. In addition, don't want to loose original images/videos and their metadata (time and place taken, etc), but shrinking them prior to upload would do so. In short, the recent changes have messed up a system that used to work well for me.

The editing features on Google photos was the main reason that I used it. Now you can do hardly anything! Plus, when you do edit a picture, it saves a copy of the photo at the end of the album; entirely pointless. Aside from a few shiny new features, this is a massive step backwards. I will have to look for another way of organising and editing my photos if this is not fixed! Just realised that you now can't cast from the app either! What an absolute shocker of an update!

There's an incompatibility with Samsung phones that recognizes both screenshots and camera as the same folder. It's a bit annoying to delete everything. Also, we need better services in Brazil, specially now that it's going to be a paid service. Such as the Photo Book. I'm really looking forward to ordering one of those. Actually, it would work as a storage buffer: we could print some pictures and then delete from the cloud to save space in some cases

I had a terrible experience with this app. I lost nearly a year’s worth of photos of my child after using it, which is extremely upsetting. The app’s behavior around storage and photo management was confusing and led to consequences I did not expect. I strongly recommend users understand the backup and deletion settings before using it. This experience seriously damaged my trust in the app and the company Google behind it. It would like to give -100 rating, if possible.

The app is getting worse. It routinely assigns the wrong dates to photos, making them difficult to find. It creates albums without asking. It includes images sent to me by email as if they're mine, and provides no easy way to find them. The scrolling function doesn't have a fine enough control. There is no way to resize the image. Even though I have the app set for high quality uploads, it regularly uploads original size images, which count against storage limits. Picasa was much better.

This latest update is an absolute mess. First you changed the really, easy to use sliders for brightness, contrast and pop so it takes longer to tweak photos. Getting to grips with it but it's still a mis-step from Google. Now I have to press "Allow" every time I modify or delete a photo?! Not only that, I then have to review MY changes before it will sync those photos! Who thought this was a good idea?! AWFUL!!!

Fantastic app! Great Fun, User Friendly For Sure. The only downside is not being able to group photos without creating a album, once in the album you cannot sort them into your own order of preference. Also! I found that should you select a number of images to download in bulk, photos doesn't give you the option, you can only download to your device one at a time.

A little complex to navigate, but packed full of a wide variety of options for your photos and videos. I will say the cloud feature is excellent, and syncs across devices very quickly; it makes uploading photos to other platforms and apps really fast, and helps me back up the really important ones onto my computer when I need to. I really don't need anything else; Google Photos does so much already!

This is the WORST gallery app in the play store. It's so disappointed that it is the default photo/gallery app in many phones. I tried to backup my photos to my SD card, and it failed—then I noticed that all the photos I tried to transfer had simply vanished from my phone. Luckily, it was all back in the original folders, but photos didn't see it. I had to clear the app's data in order to get them showing up. 500 is not enough to describe a single bug in this, and there's plenty.

I tap "Library" at the bottom of the screen. Then I open any folder with pictures, open any picture. There's no star button to favourite the picture. When I tap "Photos" at the bottom of the screen, and then open a photo, there's a 🌟 button on the top of the screen, however most of the photos on my device cannot be found in the "Photos" view. A completely useless feature! In general, I also find the concept of "Photos" vs. "Library" very confusing and annoying.

Nice editing features and the sync across devices is good but the search functionality could be vastly improved. It's difficult to find anything when all photos titles are numbers and you have photos going back to 2007 and earlier. I do like the way it groups photos into genres. I would very much like the option to download/save photos via the slideshows. Once they're gone, they're in the ether and almost impossible to find again.

It's good to keep track of your photos and videos. However there's 3 flaws i can think of right now: 1. The app keeps crashing when trying to edit photos. Even after clearing the storage it didn't fix it. 2. Sometimes when you are trying to move some pictures from folder to folder, it says there was an error moving this picture or video so you have to use file manager instead. 3. When moving photos and videos to a new folder (mainly large amounts), the photos are in random order.

I love this app because I can keep all my photos and videos in one spot, and make seperate folders. There's also seperate folders, the app separates people by their face using racial recognition. You can archive or delete photos, it's really nice to be able to use the photo editor on the app as well. There are many things you can do with them. I can share photos, print photos, and I get memories sent to me and other cool things the app does with some photos. No issues so far at all!

Up until recently, Photos has been my go-to backup app for all my photos and videos. But just recently I changed my phone, and this app is having major issues. 1) It's double-backing up photos that are already backed up in my Photos cloud, 2) it's been stuck in "getting ready to backup" for 2 days now, and 3) it's not backing up all of my photos! I've done all the "solutions" posted in the forums, to no avail! Please fix this problem ASAP. Thanks.

The various editing possibilities and story/scrapbook options are very cool. And even short films made from pictures taken in quick succession are suggested to the user. You can save the edit or say no and delete it. They help remind you to backup photos and upload them to Google and you save the space on your device. Smart and the logistics have been pretty well thought through. I'm new at the photography hobby so this is perfect for me.

I love knowing every time I'm in a trusted wifi area, my photos are being preserved. Even being in the computer industry, I have lost photos. Since I started using this app (I have not lost any), I have upgraded phones and not lost anything. Plus, with the newer generation phones, other than optical zoom, they rival my camera for quality. So the photos are worthy of preserving. Almost 3 years later, and it is even more amazing than it started out.

Absolutely love Google Photos. You can customise so much in the app, & I'm always finding new things to do. You can use the magic eraser to remove something in the photo you don't like (like the mother-in-law! Lol), which is a great feature. You can create movies from photos & videos or just a lovely collage. You can also order photo books too, either in paperback or hardback. This review & features available are based on my Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra. Features may be different on other phones.

Good app! I just have to suggestions: 1. PLEASE, make it so that you can put things in the trash from an album, it is extremely annoying to have to find a photo in an album that you want to discrad, look at the date, search for that date and then trash it. 2. It would be amazing if there was a view where you could see only photos that were not in albums, that way it is easier to organize. Please take these into consideration especially the first one.

Could still do with work. Truly awful idea that you are not pre-warned about only being able to add 500 photos to an album at a time. Just spent (wasted) my time going through selecting a load of photos to add to an album and when I press add it tells me that there is a limit and DESLECTS all the photos I just selected. Where is the logic in that? At the very least, let me go back and amend my selection to remove some photos from my current selection; or warn the user beforehand that the limit is 500 photos at a time; or remove the limit - take your pick! Could also really do with being able to preview photos/videos whilst adding them to an album. It can be hard to tell what a photo/video was and if it is relevant to the album or not. Currently, you would have to add your current selection up to that point or leave the current selection, go back to photos and check photo/video to see if it is relevant, then go back to adding photos to album again.

I really want to like the service, but I've using it for a few years now and the problems seem to only get worse. First, the app is very slow when creating albums from multiple pictures, even on a high end phone and when there aren't that many pictures. And when I try to share the album around 70% of the time I get an error and it asks me to try again later. Also, the app constantly stops syncing my pictures, and I have to clear the data and start everything again, which takes many hours. And I want to be able to choose my video quality, because right now it's either a hugely overcompressed file that is barely usable, or the original file which takes tons of space and is not very optimized. So I either waste time pre-processing the videos before uploading, or have to constantly throw money so that I can store my huge files. You own Youtube, I'm pretty sure you can have a better solution to handle videos. And there should be different options for compressed/original for photos and videos, because photo quality is acceptable but video is not.

Overall, excellent. Organises all photos by date and location, and creates videos, albums, and stylised photos for you. Also cleverly gives you the option of fixing lighting on some photos. I do wish, though, that ALL automatic creations were available to view on the app assistant page, not just the most recent ones. Also, be warned: despite what it says, you seemingly CANNOT undo changes after they have been made, and once you've chosen to not make suggested changes, the option won't reappear.

This app has become so bad. It is so buggy. So buggy. And I don't mean the "not working" kind of buggy. It messes with your photos. It's that kind of buggy. It automatically tampers with the dates, location metadata, edits made to the photos, and so much more. It occasionally refuses to back up pictures without reason, as well. Moreover, the face grouping, although very accurate, sucks. If you manually add a person, it won't ever automatically group other photos together. I am tired of this app.

With the recent updates, the app has become difficult to use. The old desgin and navigation was much easier. Why change something that isn't broken??? Also, 1. No easy way to quickly see backup status of photos at a glance. Have to open each photo and then an icon at the top right indicated this. Why can't you show an icon on the photos in the photos page? 2. When freeing up space, why can't I select which photos to delete?? Why all or nothing? The new policy is going to make me leave anyways.

Weirdly slow and annoying music in the memories. When looking through my gallery, it takes a while to load the thumbnails, even though the photos are all on my phone. Using the native gallery App shows all instantly. This makes browsing the photos a huge chore. Additionally, please allow muting the music during memories and other reels. I just want to be able to see and hear my videos and photos. It makes it very distracting, and sometimes the music is not appropriate for the context.

Best photo app, easy to create albums and share it with the family. The storage plan is great and can be shared with other family member. Some gadget features like album automation or albums from few years ago are a very nice touch. The map is also a very nice way to explore the photos. Love the sync feature above all, kudos and great job for the team working on it.

Had always worked as required but now will not open. It tries to start up but crashes every time. Also, how difficult would it be to make the link the developer replied with clickable? Or selectable so I could copy and paste it to the browser on my phone? Having to flip between apps whilst trying to remember a seemingly random series of letters and numbers doesn't help with the frustration. If there is already a way for me to do this easily, it's not obvious to an old geezer like me.

Not sure if this is part of some financial strategy or a bug but: I've ordered a photo book month ago. And in order to do so I had to select photos and "wizard" organized them in book. It was cool cause I've selected 76 photos (book can have 100 pages) but algorithm did some magic by creating collages etc. So I was like 6-7 pages more than basic book. Now, after a month, same s enario, different photos and I get photo per page. Had to do all the work on my own which wasn't so easy because of poo

I've always like this app but the most recent update includes the "blur" tool on every photo I've ever taken, not just ones in portrait mode. I can now edit the blur position, strength and depth on normal images rather than just portrait mode ones. The results are excellent, no different to if they were taken in portrait mode, which seems to have been improved as well.

The app is being more and more strict about making a user switch to cloud. It is getting so difficult to manage the storage specially when all the Google photos are also counted under 15GB free space. To download a set of backed up photos on phone, you can only do it one by one. I spent last 2 hours figuring out how to do it, but they have already made life so much harder. Looking for another app to manage photos from now on.

This application is really good at least my photos are now safe and available across all my devices. I have 2 observations that I would like Google to think about; 1. The app needs to have ability to find and show us duplicate photos in the case of duplicate photos with an option to either delete one, all or skip. 2. In the album section, it would be nice if only photos that do not belong to any group will be shown. For some with so many albums it's difficult to arrange photos based on albums.

I think it's awesome to have free unlimited high quality compressed photo backups. I also love the automatic effects. Sometimes it randomly makes an animation out of your photos, other times it's a slideshow with music. I just like being surprised by these little extras when they happen. The auto adjust feature is pretty good. I often use it first and then adjust the settings more myself and find that it's quite a bit faster than doing it all from scratch.

Great to be able to access my phone photos from any device. Update - 5 years on: I've now got 1000s of photos & upgraded to paid storage. The most frustrating thing is not being able to find what I need. I have a mixture of personal & business photos (so many cakes!) I would love to be able to tag the photos so I can easily find a specific cake - for example #coffee #cake #birthday #2x8". However the only way to add that info is in the description & that's useless as it isn't searchable 😣

Love it but there are things I don't quite understand. Albums: there's has to be sorting options. You can only see the photos chronologically. I have shared albums with my family. We upload there photos we really like and it's getting crowded. I get a notification when someone upload a new photo to one of those albums and I have to scroll manually to the bottom. And that's the other thing about albums. There's no scroll bar within albums. Everything else in the app has scroll bar and I'm waiting to see it implemented as well on albums. I've already asked it months ago in a feedback. The other thing, minor but useful too, is that i wish I could tag people in order to see them when I select their faces. There are some photos that it doesn't recognize their faces and sometimes I'd like to tag a person just because that's their back

I love using gphotos. I am not an advanced user... just someone who has a phone with very little storage, so the ability to automatically store in the cloud is critical. The only feature I'd like to see added is the ability to organize items in the same way that other Google services do... with tags/labels. I've tried to use albums for this purpose, but it's not meant for that and gets too difficult to manage as the number of albums increases.

I miss Samsung Gallery so much you don't even know. there, I could search for text within an image, I had so many image modification options, I could tag and organize with ease. this app closes when you so much as acknowledge that there are other apps on your phone. pictures in the main view don't even show in the order they're added to the device, and some folders and albums just aren't visible at all. on top, it's always nagging at you to back up your files and use AI tools so that they can ch

Would be good if I could manually label photos the AI hasn't recognized. Like photos of people or pets that haven't been labeled. "Unlimited" storage is misleading, although it's still a great deal. You can only upload a limited amount of photos in their original quality, though I think the unlimited quality is plentifully high for most people.

The latest update moved the most used functions as far away as possible adding many more clicks just to get to them. Completely removed function to freely crop photos. When editing the photo takes less than 25% of the screen - hard to see details, very hard to crop. It looks like the target audience needs only one button - "ai, make it beautiful!" Luckily you can deinstall all updates and go back to its original version!!! 5 stars for that!

I'm a longtime user of this app and I've always found it incredibly useful with a decent amount of tools for basic photo editing. It has a very easy to use interface too. I would like to see the ability to mirror flip images, to share photos directly in other apps without needing to manually download them first (they should get temporarily downloaded to send across and then cleaned up), and to allow the user to choose photos to stack together, not just limiting it to the AI to sort.

Poor app for anything other than backing the photos. Simple sharing doesn't work; when I try to upload to Instagram, I can only send a direct message with a link or a shared album. Album management is a mess; they appear in random order than I can't change, and have random image as a cover which I don't seem to be able to change either. Images I doodle on with Markup seem to disappear and I'm unable to find them - why is such a simple thing not working? The icons for favourite photos disappear from the grid view in Albums (you can see them in Photos). All of the above is particularly annoying on Pixel 2 as you're stuck with this app. I kind of miss other Android photo apps from other manufacturers - which I shouldn't.

I still love this app, that's why I rated it 5 stars! However, I didn't like the little changes it had after an update! Those "favorites, utilities, archive, and trash" shouldn't be displayed in the upper corner of the library!—especially the trash! I used to store them some private photos that I don't wanna get exposed, but also I wanted to stay for a while if I ever change my mind! If they are visible that way, people may check what's in there because they look enticing!

The app is kinda ok, but has flaws! I don't like, that you don't have an easy method, to select a lot of photos. You have to click them individually, one by one and then you can't even move them in another folder on your device. I still use the app, because it's convenient, but there are better photo apps on the playstore, that aren't as restrictive with YOUR OWN EFFING PHOTOS!!!

Great! It backs up your photos (if you allow it) and makes it easy for you to find photos and memories way back! I like the categorising of people, its great there is a "confirm more pictures option" but perhaps could improve if we could move them to the name itself or move around from the different names cause some are wrong. 😅 But overall quite accurate! Recommend to people who are messy and unorganised HAHA! Oh and a great function is that we can create animations, collages and movies! 😊

Working horribly now... App crashing a lot working with new album I created. It has many photos, but still very much below limit of 2000. Many times to remove a photo from the album have to do it twice. Selecting some photos from the album goes to the wrong ones. Photos that were previously deleted appear again when scrolling the album. When it works it is not bad!

I want to be able to do the things I did in my i-phone, prior to switching to Android. I could briefly check my photos on a daily basis on my phone and quickly move them to various photo albums. It was then much easier to quickly find what I wanted to share with friends or family at a moment's notice. Photo sharing issues between my Mac, iPad and Android phone are extremely frustrating and annoying as I can't sync them with my phone any more so have two separate and different photo libraries.

I wish certain photos could be filtered from the main view. Why can’t I say “exclude photos with X object/person” from the main view. EX: If someone is no longer in my life, I should be able to exclude photos of them from the main view; the same could apply to many different subjects. I’ve taken photos of my physique and it’s awkward that it’s mixed with everything else. Archive isn’t a good enough solution because everything is still mixed together, but now my receipts are in there too.

Few feedback . If I search for an album, currently only those uploaded by me are shown and not those shared with me in search results. . A time delay option should be made available before the uploads starts. You see I am. Not a pro photographer, I do make mistakes and I would like to delete those mistakes before it gets uploaded. The delay will allow me to delete/edit photos before it gets uploaded. . The album search is not always handy. It shows photos but many albums which I know are there are not shown. I have to manually scroll through all of. The albums to get it. . The most irritating part, if I share a pic with someone,the app should just give me a link to share which it does but it also for some strange reasons creates a new album with that photo. This eventually ends up clogging my album gallery. You can just give a link using which people can view / download.

A true gallery! Much more than just a place dumped with all your photos. Few Improvements: 1. While adding photos to existing album, there's no way to search for the album. Have to scroll through the entire list of albums to find out the one I'm looking for. 2. Would be great if "Hide People" option really hides ALL the photos they're present in. 3. App displays all the info about a photo (date taken, people, location, etc) - would be great if it also shows the album(s) it belongs to.

The product is great but there are a lot of issues with synchronization in the app. The website works fine. I keep on having these issues where I add photos in an album, get a message saying they have been added, go back to list albums only to find out the photos were not really added! This is very annoying. I always end up tracking the photos that were not properly synced and upload them manually. Then from the web I add them to the album. Hope you can fix this issue.

Updated review May 2023. Another google product that seems to get worse over time. Free forever? Nope, that turned out to be a lie. Cannot choose whether you want to backup videos so the paltry data allowance gets eaten up constantly. Seems to purposefully get in your way of using the allocated storage effeciently. Used to be my favorite app, now I am looking for a better alternative.

A bit fast, but good if I can keep up on it. Too easy to accidentally press onto the next stage, so I feel a back step is needed, probably is on better mobile telephone. And so that's what I get for trying to make do with a cheaper mobile telephone, although it was bought for me by a family member. And so left in it's box for months it seems to me. You need more on what to look for, so a typing in way for things I like and don't want again please would be the way, and a highlight touch way.

Be careful you don't exceed your storage!App will destroy many of your photos, especially if edited. And will likely delete your entire locked folder. Happened to me Managing and editing photos easy. Recently experienced an issue where my entire catalog of 1000s of photos seemed to have been manipulated. I don't know if some AI program cropped the photos but it was absurd. Heads cut off, people cut out of group photos. Made no sense at all. Now I have to go through them all and restore original.

The UI is a bit confusing and not so friendly. Wish I could have the option of seeing the pictures "individually" (a general gallery where they are only organized by month -THIS is the way they always appear-). AND also being able to see them organized in ALBUMS (the same albums I already have on my phone gallery), because it's more confusing and hard to find the way it is now on the app (everything is mixed, only organized by month)

the photo sharing feature "Share in Photos" was previously very good and had very little delay. Now it is super slow, often several days before people receive the photos. It has also gotten way worse with notifications where receiving photos does not trigger any notifications on both my end and those that I send media to. Also the way media is shared now is very confusing, I always have to look where the share is. I have several "conversations" with the same recipient for some reason. Please fix

This app is a nightmare, every time I try to organize my pics it messes them up more and more. No possibility to organize the pics in folders, but only in albums. Albums do not show nicely your pics, nor the date. When syncing my older pics from another telephone, all my folders were deleted and the dates reseted to the day of the sincronizacion... Impossible to find a pic ... unfortunately, I don't know any other app I could use to sync my telephone pics...

There is no option to mass download pictures. The inability to do so forces you not only to keep your files there, but it also means you cannot have a physical backup. Cannot choose what folders to back up and what folders to ignore. Very annoying to go through. If you redownload all of your files through their exports, your photos/videos are entirely different. If you lose the original you'll never see it again. File sizes are slightly smaller so I can only assume they've been compressed

I used my Google account for several years without issue. Then suddenly, my storage is full. Turns out Google photos had been doing backups without me knowing. I deactivated that and deleted all pictures to free up space. A few weeks later, the same issue with my storage, even though I turned the backups off. I turned it off again, and when I tried deleting the pictures, they were also deleted from my phone. I am not buying more storage, I don't need it.

Clean, simple, intuitive. Love it. Especially the user interface. Been using it since the early days. Constant updates. Just a slight problem. It would be nice to have the download button more easily accessed or to be easily found for other beginner users. OH and to drag multiple images to select and download. The current download style is opening a single photo, then download, which kinda is a letdown when you want to download the whole album. THIS GOOGLE. PLEASE. Always look forward to your updates. 😊

Extremely frustrating.I like my photos organised but I can't do this. I don't want 1000s of photos all jumbled up in one place. When I add them to an album, they should automatically be removed from the jumble, because I can't tell which are in albums and which are not. Then. I also can't move photos in, the wrong album, into, the correct album. So I went on the help section. But I have no option to copy, or to move to another folder. Mine's broken. This is really simple basic stuff Google!!

The apps good and everything.. but it doesn't retain the photos in the original album names from which its backing them up. As a result one has to manually create an album and select the photos one by one and add them. Also, when the app backs up the photos later, u hav to manually add newly added photos to the album. So in the library all sorts of photos from ur phone albums are gng to be added all in one place wch is like a big mess. One cannot find the photo they might be looking for without wasting so much of their time. Please add the feature that where the app backs up photos in the same order and categories/folders from wch it is backing up in the phn.

I LOVE that come what may, my photos are automatically backed up. I also love that I can search photos by content, like "food" "beach" etc and its actually very accurate. For some reason it seems won't upload random pictures sometimes. Its rare, but i wish I knew why. Please (!) get a duplicate photo deletion feature. Sometimes photos end up both on my phone and computer, or may have the file name changed, and gets uploaded twice. With thousands of photos, its a pain to comb through deleting

The recent search function on the app is very frustrating. Before, I could search chronologically. Now when you search, it brings out all the pictures and videos all lumped up, even from as far as three or four years ago without any categorization. Even the "Best Match" function does not do its job as I keep seeing pictures and videos I took in a certain month appear in another month. It makes it tedious to begin finding your pictures and photos. I am really frustrated by this upgrade.

I really like this app. It used to not be very useful to me when it wouldn't allow you to do basic edits like cropping, but now it does! It keeps all of my photos in one place, even from past devices through my Google account. It also had a page that suggests automatic stylized edits for some photos (you dont have to use them though). All around it's a solid app!

It's really slow to load photos! The gallery can't keep up when you scroll. It will show a gray image and then a pixelated version of the photo. In comparison, Samsung's app is near instant. And zooming into a photo while being in the editor, you see a low-resolution preview of the image. Overall, the editor layout and functions are a chore!! When swiping up to reveal details of the photo, there is a big stutter. For memories and some basic functions, you have to upload all photos to the cloud!?

This upgrade is useless. Editing photos has become a right chore. The magic eraser is not precise like it was before. Takes out what it likes rather than what you highlight it to take out. Even when you enhance a photo, it keeps saying "Unable to save" Like I said, it's a totally useless upgrade. Wish I'd have turned off the automatic upgrade now.

1. Long screenshots can't be backuped up which is ridiculous. 2. Easy in-app feedback feature was removed. 3. Still can't easy delete all the stored photos at will. 4. There is no way to sort files in albums. 5. There's no way to merge albums. 6. There's no way to select all files. 7. There is no easy way to tell if a file was created after free space in the apk ended.

After the recent upgrades, I lost one editing feature that I used the most. Scanning a tilted document, by auto adjusting the corners. I cannot find any other alternatives for that. There are a lot of AI features now but I can't see any option that does that. The document scan option produces PDF, not an image. Please bring back a convenient way to scan documents that produce images. Till then it's a 3 star for me.

This is based on one experience. The app suggested i free up space and that i could access the items after removal because they were backed up. Did not say what was being removed (which is slack and just rude) but i went with it. Turns out it was deleting my photos off my device! I don't have data, I'm not always wifi connected when i access my photos. If your so clever Google why didn't you think this might be an issue for users! I want my photos back on my device. All of them. In camera file!

You should look at the Samsung Gallery, It's a good example to follow. -We need to be able to select a cover photo when we're in photos on device section. -In photos on device section, we need to be able to order our albums like we want it. It's UX, sometimes you don't want to see some pictures at the top or you want to keep the most important albums at the top. Sometimes you want to keep the albums in the same place. That's frustrating. These are the minimum requirements you should consider.

Personally downloaded it for the back up feature which I think should be brought to Gallery Go. My issue is that folders in the app should be given the option to arrange them via: 1. Alphabetically 2. Date modified.....just like Gallery Go. It is VERY difficult searching for pictures amongst tens/hundreds of picture folders like me. I don't need to add them to an album for a good arrangement. Secondly, when I select a photo to TRASH, it keeps prompting me to allow photos move to trash. Fix 🙏

I love Google photos. It's hassle free and does everything for me from backing up photos, creating great movies, animations and collages with ongoing advice on storage options. For me, it's a safe, reliable and easy way to manage all my photos with peace of mind that they are backed up and readily available for anytime in the future. The albums and memories that it creates are fantastic too!

I like the app and it works well with the Pixel 7 Pro features. I would rate the app better if it wasn't for the really annoying "unable to edit, check your connection" error that has been happening since January this year. I can edit while a picture is still in the camera folder but as soon as you move it to another folder you can no longer edit it.

Been using this app for years mostly for the purpose of backing up my photos and it has worked seemlessly. Unfortunately do not at all understand the change in Your Map, it was one of my most used functions. Now you have to go to settings and look for photos with location to be able to see the map. Extremely unhappy, as the "Places" option groups photos rather arbitrarily and never shows everything I want in one place, so it takes extra unnecessary steps to access the map.

I've tried most of those kind of apps, and I can vouch for this one that it's the best there is out there, at least at this moment, and I'm using it for years (and at the same time trying others all the time ). For the lack of better words, my only objection/dislike is so many additional "photo gadgets", but I guess you are keeping up with trends and what your customers want. Nevertheless, I'm still among your No1 fans. Keep up the good work, all the best and take care! Sincerely, Milica Milena

I'm liking the app very much, though I would love to receive more collages and more regularly. I received a lot in the beginning but now only fеw. Update: this seems to have been fixed and I'm very happy now :) The only thing that I would like to see improved is sliding between pictures - could be a lot smoother and zooming too. Mind you, I'm using and iPhone and a one plus 7 pro, so it's not a hardware issue.

I'm very disappointed. I want to express that with Google Photos, every time I have large videos, they automatically back up, which fills my free storage immediately. I wish there was an option in the backup settings to back up photos and videos separately. I want backup to always be on for photos only, but unfortunately, there is no option for this

This is a really good app. But please do something about the locked folder photos. They aren't backed up yet some of them hold really special memories, only that we just want to keep them to ourselves. Coz as it is now , if I lose my phone, they are all gone. And I think the folder needs to have a different passcode, different from the one one uses to unlock the phone.

Unable to save when editing photos. On my phone, when editing a picture I'm unable to save the changes, the button simply won't work, to be fair, neither the cancel button. All the other features work fine. As well, I don't understand why, after backing up pictures, the app mix up and put all in the same folders, including pictures we received from instant messaging apps.

I really like Google and I really like this app. However, since updating it, there has been nothing but problems with the backup. First of all, it uses MASSIVE amounts of data, so don't use it on a data plan. The only problem is there is no WiFi only backup setting anymore. I have seen multiple people run into this problem and it can freeze up an entire WiFi network in seconds. On top of that, there has been no reply from Google concerning the problem when I have messaged them.

It's a great app for backing up and sharing but when it auto sorts photos into "things" (airplanes, cliffs, etc) you can't change where they are. It thinks that a bird is a plane and a night light is food, but I can't do anything to move the photo to the correct category. Please make this a feature. Otherwise a great app.

Google photos is an abomination, it's whole process is laid out in the most convoluted manner. Let's say I want to select images from the jumble of photos on my device to back up, move (not copy) them into their unique named folder for ease of future use, while simultaneously deleting them from my phone. But photos can't do that, no, you have to back them ALL up, then dig for the photos to keep. Also, why do I have to delete from device and cloud, I'd like to choose one or the other!

Handy, misleading and intensely intrusive. No, you will not be able to summon your archived photos from the ether - unless you have round-the-clock WiFi access, of course. Neither are the editing tools anything to squeal from the rooftops. The solution? Get yourself a nice little hard drive with some decent cheap photo-editing software...and if, later, you choose to upload duplicates to your Google Drive or indeed your whatever: good for you.

Non user-friendly. Too much unnecessary stuff. But doesn't allow for the most obvious functions like "arrange by date", at least you have to purposely look for it (I still couldn't find). Photos are a total mess and I can't find a way to sort them. Rather have no fancy nonsense, but just a simple library by date where I can scroll and find the pictures taken.

The options are out of this world. You can set your camera to infinite gradations of raw, JPG, HRD+ etc settings. The app actually teaches even seasoned photographers more finely honed skills all the time. And it still allows you to revert to purely manual control. I wish I had this years ago, when I developed an interest in photography when my kids were little. You look at old photos from negatives and you cry. The dark sky option is an unbelievable bonus.

The most recent update that forced its way onto my device has the app running slower than ever. I have an old device, and as you're such a large company, it is your duty to make sure that your applications run on all devices that you force them on and that they run at an acceptable speed on ALL these devices, even the oldest models. The slowness of this application due to your most recent mistake of an update is unacceptable. Revert the update.

It's pretty good app for what it is. I like how it recognizes everyone's face that I took photos of and puts them in a seperate collection. Although it's missing a basic function: video speed. It's kinda annoying that I have to download another app just to play a video a tiny bit slower. Also I haven't been getting any of those memory collections that I used to get everyday even though the option is on. I liked those but now I only get like one every 6 months.

The only app you'll need to manage your photos and videos. Also, Make collages, movies, animations and of course, editing tools for your photos. Great for sharing.. Google photos also makes up suggestions on collages. No need to search any further. However, it used to have 'stylised photos' which Google would choose and ask if you wanted to save it. This seems to have gone???

Changed to 1 star now because the updates are making the app useless... I can't act on a group of photos selected inside a shared album e.g. delete, add to another album, add to favourites, etc... This is so annoying!! I used to be able to share photos directly to an album, but I can't anymore... I really hope you bring the functionalities back... Also, it would be nice to be able to share albums privately (w/o creating a link).

A decent app for basic photo editing and mostly storage if you don't care about the size/resolution. It has a few downsides: 1) Like batch editing (like in Picasa) to auto-enhance selected photos. 2) Sorting by Albums is a miss; need much more fine-grained controls. 3) Need a lot more filters than what is available. 4) The steps to upload from Drive suck big time; requires unnecessary clicks and the window that pops up cannot be resized. 5) No option to directly save/download Photos to my Phone.

Too many frequent pop-up prompts about everything from "Do you want to buy a print of this picture?" to "Do you want to crop/edit this picture?" etc. Even though I have dismissed them hundreds of times, they just keep on coming back like an ex-girlfriend that just won't let go. Google needs to chill out on this front. Otherwise a great gallery app that syncs to the cloud, just a few minor bugs here and there — nothing too serious or cumbersome though.

Alright Google, it's a solid app. But here's the deal, we've become accustomed to this behaviour where my photos are backed up. Now that this will take up my limited amount of free space, I'm FORCED to pay OR not use the service. Well I'm not paying. Plain and simple. I have my own personal cloud storage device. I just happen to like your UI a bit better. Plus the AI is better. BUT, I pay for Amazon Prime. They offer free storage for my photos now. Sooooo, you're really losing access to ALL of my new photos, and not gaining anything from me. I'd highly recommend you reconsider this decision. In the very least, allow for a CERTAIN amount of space BEFORE it adds on to your storage. Like, allow 100 free full size photos a month. That's 3 photos a day roughly. That's fair. And wouldn't take up TOO much space. I'd be a bit more conscious about what I'm backing up and whatnot, but that's fine. I tend to just take a bunch of burst shots and save them all but I only really need the best one. Anyway, that's all. You are now just an archive of old photos. Unless there is a free storage option, I won't be uploading any photos to this. Thank you.

This is a very broken app and incredibly hard to use. All the pages make no sense, the search makes no sense, albums don't work, they don't upload correctly, hard to add images consistently, they randomly disappear from albums. You can't select several images from rapid shots. Slow motion videos are still broken. This app would be a lot better if they just grabbed the code from 2 years ago and called it "Classic Photos" because that's how long since it's worked correctly

Nice app. Good way to back up your photos. I like the album feature. They are always there when you need them. The edit feature is nice. I like the Chromecast slide show feature but the algorithm is bad because it keeps showing the same pictures over and over again when there are hundreds that are never shown. Also if I delete a photo from Photos it should not delete it from my phone. Certain filles are supposed to be kept separate.

Started in a recent version to create artificial albums to make into a photo book which I would have to pay for. This album included pictures of dead animals taken for veterinary purposes together with sunsets. There needs to be an agreement first for photos to suggest items to album-ize, delete, etc - an 'opt-in', not an 'opt out'. And as to its suggestions for rotation! Its algorithms are way out.

when I started using this application, it was great! many pictures were perfectly fine for storage. Now every time I open the application, it says, I don't have enough storage. It is such a headache connecting my mobile to my laptop and transferring all my pictures and videos. It seems as if your application is not working on backing up pictures on daily basis. There are so many complaints, shouldn't your developers take note and make this app better. There is no use for our feedback.

It's the worst photo app! When you're out of storage you're screwed. They force you to pay. You can't transfer photos to your computer (you can but every 2-3 photos are in separate folders. I have over a 1000 so I have to open each folder). The other option is to back up your photos to the cloud. You can't select photos to back up. It's either all of them or none! Extremely inconvenient! And of course you'll be out of storage in the cloud too so you have to pay! That's why I went back to Apple!

Having problems with organising album using Android OS. I have to use my PC to ensure the uploaded photos are really added into my desired album. Is a double job. Can't select photo to be album cover, can't download photos from the app, all have to be done by PC version now. Heck, it never happened before! Please fix it. This was the best image storage app ever.

Great way to keep all your photos without running out of space on your device. You're always able to look at them whenever you want, plus you can also download any special photo back into your device for special occasions or whatever reason you so desire. You can share with your family friends very easily too. Lots other features. Great app to have, I'm very glad I have it.

So impressed. It does so much! So much that it makes me want it to do a couple of extra things that is over and beyond. Like being able to put info of a photo appear visible in the album with the photo rather than having to go into it ie. a comments addition. 2. I'm a mum and would love an age timer for the photos. This would supersede all baby milestone apps. I've tried a few but don't like because it misses all these google functions. Love this app!

No folder management, not able to delete file from cloud without deleting on mobile (happens if by default uploaded to cloud and you don't want there). No way to organize photos. It keep asking photos with similar face (I get it you need confirmation for one or two photos but not all) dialogs didn't expect from this AI. No more high quality storage and also you showed us, you can change terms any time (yes, by proving time but we may also not like those terms).

Mostly decent. Pretty basic though. Free uploads is the best part. Not having the ability to favourite or hide photos is a big omission though at this stage. Also, the aggressive software algorithm it uses to try to 'stabilize' videos after you try to edit them into a compliation and save them makes them unwatchable unfortunately. Needs the ability to turn this feature off as otherwise it's unusable.

It's a great app, but it just doesn't work fine. When I need to delete photos, sometimes I have to delete same photos for several times, just because there are some blank white spaces left, that after reboot turns back into photos I deleted. And at the end, when I have to delete a lot of photos from both my device and account, after few minutes of cleaning it just stops deleting and pressing delete button just doesn't change anything... Moreover, syncing between devices could be better, because every time I need to transfer video from my laptop and I use Google photos I just cannot download video, it just says try in few minutes, and sometimes it could take hours... I'm aware of syncing data between servers, but in that case don't just write try again in few minutes, write something more realistic... Furthermore, sometimes there are minor bugs, such as syncing photos between my devices, when I upload photo from pc, it just doesn't show up in the photos app on my phone, but everywhere else those photos are present, even in web interface in chrome... And in that cases I have to upload my photos several times, just so that they appear in app, but then finally they all appear and I have to delete duplicated ones... So please, Google, update your app, so that it wasn't that laggy, because for me, person, that use photos app many times a day, sometimes it just gets annoying to use it, and I simply think about switching to alternatives....

Have been using this app for the past year or so. It's been great! can't say enough about it. Everything including updates that regularly improve the app itself, easy to use self syncing, automatically sorts the junk photos and suggests which ones to use. As a small business man who's work includes the taking of many photos from 3-5 different devices on a regular basis this app not only does it all but does it all for you. Thanks Google. top marks from this customer !😉👍

Add the option to rename the photos/videos (which are no longer in our devices) added to albums, please! And the option to add tags to the photos/videos, so that way we could easily find them, because a lot of times certain words doesn't give any result or we want to find photos of a particular person, please. This app could be amazing but it needs a lot of fixing!

The July 2025 update to Google Photos is much harder to use than the previous version and some of the old functionality (like freeform cropping) doesn't even work on the new version. Options are spread across a range of different "buttons" so are harder to find, and adjustment sliders are far too sensitive, making small adjustments very difficult. Unless you only want to apply standard filters to your photos you'll find yourself having to look elsewhere for a different tool to edit your photos.

My photos aren't in the app. Some appear but 99% can only be accessed from my Files app. Sorting is just bad (no sub folders is a pain for someone with many pictures). When editing, you can only "Save as copy" so you have to delete the original after editing. The only feature I needed and used (adjusting pictures of documents) became premium and now I can only rely on the "Automatic" button. Wish I could delete this app but it's preinstalled. Gotta find a decent gallery app additionally now.

This app is great. You can see all your photos and it is better than any default android gallery and it's really handy to back up your photos. The problem is that it is extremely hard to organise your photos. For example there is no way to delete a photo from the cloud without deleting it from your phone as well. WE NEED THIS FUNCTION GOOGLE! If this feature was added this would easily be 5 stars.

The app is incredible. Knowing that I have access to photos long gone from my gallery is amazing. HOWEVER, the new policy, which puts an end to free unlimited storage is a big big bummer. I mean, money is great, but forcing us to buy more storage when it eventually runs out is for me a terrible move from Google. It probably won't change, but I'm just expressing my opinion here :/

My biggest pet peeve is the lack of providing decent photo editing. I'm not looking for Photoshop or even 'Photoshop 3.0', I used 1994. Google Photos should at least be able to do editing similar or better than 'Image Pro' (Pre-Photoshop) from 30 years ago (1988). My Google Android Oreo 8.0 has a better OS than the Apple 2 DOS 3.3, which 'Image Pro' (on floppy disk) used to run. Even less a little less would be better than Google Photo offers for photo editing

I absolutely love Google photos. It kept all of my photos and videos safe and secure throughout the year. But now I've got to pay a monthly subscription for more space. If I could at least purchase some storage so it's 100% mine. It's ridiculous, how else am I supposed to store all the photos and videos I take? I have so many, had to move to one drive (1TB limit). Truly disappointing.

There are ways this app can be improved. The app can warn about how much of the available cloud space would it take up or have a function to limit how much media to be backed up. Some careless users (like me) can easily back up a lot of media, unaware of the 15GB free storage limit, and screw the account over. I had to spend the next hours recovering them following that as there was no clear way of "un-backing up" the media, and deleting them in the cloud also gets them deleted locally.

editing my review and giving 1 star. Latest photos aren't visible in the app. Takes about 6-8 hours literally to be visible in the grid. Older photos either doesn't loads or takes huge time to load even the ones that are saved/downloaded in my phone memory. 6 out of 10 times I can't see the cast option. Randomly and suddenly sometimes mixes other people's photos in other people's folder while sorting according to faces even after me correcting and cancelling same photo multiple times.

There is no way to clear photos of poor quality, duplicates, screenshots, memes, etc. which takes up additional space and clutters up the library. The facial recognition is poor and only finds a small number of faces, if any, and there is no way to log them manually. The searching and sorting functions are good albeit limited. A decent app but just not what it could be.

Its been fixed. I find that if I am out of date and not current with updates this pops up again. However it is nothing like it was. The grouping tools are awesome too. I have lots of animals and often need a photo of an individual one, it recognises the differences in my dogs, or horses. It's great! I'm having issues with it not automatically uploading my videos. when I go in individually it says they are uploading... but it's been days...

Ran out of space online. The page informing you has a handy button saying free up space. It's not clear that it's on the phone not online - and then it deleted ALL of my photos on the phone, without so much as a "are you sure" window, and it doesn't look like i can recover them. So if I wanted to switch to some other app it's now much harder. Thanks Google photos. You have now really made me want to go to the competition.

Bad UX. Saved a modified version of a not-so-recent photo from an album? Good luck finding it ever again in the whole feed. Trying to export a photo to another folder so that it's easier to find in other apps? You can't. Upload dialog blocking UI waiting for network? Tough luck, now you can't use the app until you have network again or kill it. Can't add selection of photos to more than one album. Can't see what albums a photo is already part of.

I instantly, regret, paying for storage, just to see how bad this is when it comes to selecting photos and overall systems compared to the actual gallery from the original device. I got no time to select one by one randomly, and the thing is, when I tried to copy my photos from my album to this app, it turns out the folder placed in my internal device, not the app, that now, all the date of the photos are messed up. Change your systems, it's complicated and disappointing.

I just used the option to free up space and now the app it's just a mess of unorganized photos sorted by date only. I'd like to have the option to at least create albums that automatically fill with pics from a certain device folder so I don't have to deal with this mess. I like my photos organized by decice folder but albums olny let me fill them automatically with photos of certain people or pets.

This is just poor and i can't believe i thought this was the answer to my problems, far from it! Sync doesn't work, just hangs with the following messages: - getting photos OR - getting ready to backup Also, app doesn't find my photo folders half the time. tried everything from a reinstall to clear data/cache but nothing works. sharing? pointless if i can't get my photos in the cloud to begin with and seems like Google don't care from a lot of what I've read about others having similar issues.

This app used to be really good and helpful with storing all my photos, and I quite liked the "on this day" bit back in time. But now with the stupid "remember this day" and it was like two days ago, er of course I remember that day! For me it chooses to show me what happened a few days ago or earlier this month, I don't need to see that, I took the photos I should remember it! The old app with the previous years was better, please consider taking it back to the easier simple version.

The app used to be good, but now you cant manually create a new (person or pet) tag because the system shows an error to check internet connection - when there is nothing wrong with the Internet. Also, the app used to automatically tag new photos of people/pets whose tag already exist, but now it doesn't and when you try to do it manually, you get the same error. It's really a shame.

Great app! Very easy to synchronize between cell phone and laptop. I value how this app organizes photos for you based on location, features (e.g. mountains, lakes and cities), allows you to bulk-rotate photos and offers easily stylized photos. You can also create shared albums. Perhaps the most important feature is the free storage. I highly reccomend this app.

I love Google Photos. Apart from being able to store and access my photos from different devices, I have to say that the photo editing tools are just great. It's unbelievable some of the edits that can come out from the basic editing tools. 👌👌Really like the additional features it's been bringing such as the highlights and the photo map. I like using the vignette feature but not being able to apply it to other margins if the focus falls on one side can be a downside.

It used to be THE app I advised everyone to install, but for now, with that upload limit and paywall, you're far better off buying yourself a couple of usb keys or external SSD.. I get storage is expensive and upload would have keep increasing, but going from unlimited free to that is a huge drop. Maybe someday they'll increase the free storage or something, but at least, until then, it could give the opportunity for other cloud providers to get more people and offer better deals.

I love this app. I rely on it my entire life. I would like to make a suggestion. Can you please add a search feature to look for a specific album name when adding photos. I have many albums. So it takes long time to scroll down a list of albums when you want to add photos to a specific album. Im sure the users need that feature too. Please make it happen 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 I would give 5 stars if you make it happen.

Usually good, but every update breaks it more. After editing photos, either with the markup tool or by cropping them, I can't save the changes. The "done" button exists, but nothing happens when you press it. Can't uninstall/reinstall as it's a system app. Tried force stopping it and clearing the cache. Nope. I wish there was the option to install the previous version of the app.

It keeps saying it has stopped working and I can't even upload or download pictures, documents and videos. Sometimes I will download a picture or video and just about minutes after viewing, the video can't play and the pictures are blurred. It is a very useless and irritating app, I try to uninstall it but it is just there. Google can't answer when I send a complaint.

This app is not trustworthy. Failing to upload pictures and albums and a very messy gallery. Rarely the actual date of the picture is the same as the date on the gallery, finding myself looking around all the gallery for what I'm looking for. Years ago Google Photos was working properly and just lately (around one year) it got too much messy.

This app is usually pretty good, but recent updates have hidden a lot of my favourite features away without a way to access them. For example, there used to be an entire section for "suggested for you" which kept the automatically created collages, animations, and stylised photos in one spot that was easy to access. Now, if I dismiss a notification for an automatic creation, I'll probably never find it again.

I'm really enjoying the app, it's amazing. I just have a suggestion, if you guys can modify so I can browse my backed up photos in folders, just as I backed it up! If you can include it as an option apart from grouping the pictures. This will really save a lot of time I spend searching for a particular picture in the past. Great job guys!!

Downloading this app was a necessary evil at the time. And while G made it easy to get my photos to the app, It's very difficult to get them back to my phone in bulk. I sent G an email letting them know and asking for help but no one ever responded. Other complaints... Pictures that were in folders on my phone are now scattered throughout the app by date. Also... a bigger problem... MISSING PICTURES! I ordered a laptop with a huge memory so I don't have to deal with this anymore!

This is probably the only app I'll give 5 stars. First off, it's such a valuable free service, so much online storage of photos both for archival purposes and sharing. The ability to auto backup my photos is great, if anything catastrophic happens I'm not totally pooched. The interface is intuitive and works how you'd expect it.
